visualReview.method: Actual final desktop.png and mobile.png were each opened with the image view tool. Map views were also opened in the preceding semantically identical CSS run.
visualReview.desktop: 1200×900/DPR1: clear Cinzel masthead set within original textured valley painting; balanced navigation, readable literary copy, warm CTA separation, visible lantern traveller and river; no overlap or clipping.
visualReview.mobile: 390×844/DPR1: readable title and wrapped hero line; stacked tap targets, compact navigation, framed traveller/lantern and scroll cue; comfortable margins and no clipping or horizontal overflow.
visualReview.world: Desktop lore side panel aligns with map; mobile chips remain separated and the selected lore stacks below. Warm chip focus/selection and muted background maintain hierarchy.
visualReview.limitations: Illustrations are original textured code-drawn SVG paintings, not private-template art or raster brush paintings.
